decisions.reason: The chart visualization plugin still fits the firm's web-GIS platform business well, but the lack of later website visibility suggests some risk of consolidation into broader offerings rather than active standalone expansion.

The mobile layer control component addresses a real usability need in mobile GIS projects, though as a narrower feature product with no later visibility it carries a somewhat higher risk of being folded into the core platform or retired.
The GIS solution platform is closely aligned with the firm's long-term strategic direction and flagship positioning, so it remains very unlikely to be withdrawn within the next year.
